# Calibration parameter source map

For each calibration parameter, this page lists where EcoSIM `0340d71b` reads it from the parameter file, the Fortran variable it lands in, and every physics site that uses that variable, each with its enclosing subroutine and `file:line`. It is generated from the source by `git grep`/`git show` at the pinned commit, so it cannot drift from the code; what each site MEANS is documented in the topic pages it links to (`plant_bgc/`, `microbial_bgc/`, `io_and_forcing/input_readers.md`).

A read is marked **DEAD** when its enclosing routine is never called or referenced at this commit (`PlantInfoMod.F90` keeps an uncalled per-PFT reader beside the live table reader). Site kinds: **read** = the `ncd_getvar` call; **copy** = a plain copy into another data structure; **assign** = the variable is written by an expression (a derived value or an overwrite); **use** = the variable appears on the right-hand side of physics. Declarations, allocation, `associate` bindings, history/restart I/O, trait-display writes, and sites inside routines nothing calls (**dead**) are counted but not listed. Aliases from `associate(alias => obj%Var)` blocks are followed within their routine and marked `alias`.

Parameters covered: every entry of the curated seed `models/ecosim/curated_seed.yaml`.
